Rina Patel: Evermore week0 onboarding 2-hour blockers2 - need final confirmation on two things before we schedule cutover: audit logs format + KMS key ownership. Can we close these today?

Jordan Lee: On audit logs, do they need a single-line JSONL envelope or prefer nested arrays? Ask for example if they sent one.

Rina Patel: They sent a sample. Posting here so it's in the runbook: 
```json
{"session_id":"s-9f8e","tenant_id":"evermore-prod","timestamp":"2026-03-20T09:12:34Z","event":"inference","model_version":"rwd-7b-v2","latency_ms":72,"request":{"prompt_len":32},"redaction":true}
```

Maya Torres: Good to have that. Questions about KMS: do they insist on CMK in their account? Also do they want our service to be a key administrator or just a crypto user?

Rina Patel: Their security policy: CMK owned in their AWS account (no managed keys). They want us to be a crypto user only (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) and not be able to change rotation or key policy. They asked for aliasing so ARN doesn't have to change in configs when they rotate.

Jordan Lee: Ok. We'll require the cross-account key policy that grants our service principal kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey and denies kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion. Also include condition to restrict usage to requests coming from our account ID and the Evermore VPC endpoint. I'll draft and post the policy snippet.

Rina Patel: Please do. Also networking note: Evermore has an inbound allowlist on their side and will only accept requests to their forwarder from our private endpoint IPs. They provided three static IPs for egress to their logging collector. We need to confirm which public IPs our Private deployment will present.

Maya Torres: If they're doing mTLS to our forwarder we should exchange cert fingerprints. I asked security to generate a short checklist for cert pinning and TLS rotation.

sec-bot: Security checklist (auto): - Strip raw PII from payloads before sending to logs. - Ensure audit logs include tenant_id + session_id + request_id. - Add masking step for sensitive fields at ingest. - Validate KMS key policy restricts Admin actions to Evermore's principal only.

Jordan Lee: Proposed IAM policy snippet for their role (cross-account assume):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/evermore-redwood"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999888777666:key/xyz-1234"}]}
```

Rina Patel: Thanks. Can we schedule a 20-min sync to confirm the key policy and the three static egress IPs? I can do 13:00 PT or 16:00 PT.

Maya Torres: 13:00 PT works. I'll invite Jordan and Evermore security.

ops-bot: onboarding-runbook updated by Jordan Lee 1: added "audit-jsonl-sample", "cmk-in-customer-account", "static-egress-ips" steps. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Evermore/runbook (internal)

Jordan Lee: After the call I'll post the exact runbook diff and the KMS key policy template to the Evermore security mailing list. :white_check_mark: :shipit:

Rina Patel: Great. I'll capture any post-call adjustments here and mark readiness for engineering cutover once Evermore confirms the three IPs and posts the key policy ARN.
